site.subtitle: Guide to Official Information from Public Institutions and Related Organizations
site.short_description: A guide that helps users find the responsible public institution or related organization and proceed to that organization's own official information during disasters and other situations.
site.purpose: Helps users reach official information from public institutions and related organizations quickly.
site.free_use_notice: Free to use. There are no ads or affiliate links, and no sign-in is required.
site.external_site_notice: Destinations are external official websites. Check the linked site for the latest information.
site.disclaimer_summary: This is not an official government website, breaking-news service, or fact-checking service. Listing does not guarantee the overall reliability of an organization or the accuracy of information at a destination.
